actual.red: By the time Wendel Red reached S-F1, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A bullet found Wendel Red at S-F1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Red. Wendel Red read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F1 with the rations. Wendel Red ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Wendel Red was carried in at last.
A surgeon stopped at Wendel Red's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news.
ethanlam724: At the depot, Gustav Ethanlam had practised answering to his name. At R-S11, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Gustav Ethanlam brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Gustav Ethanlam and Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
oaustin77: Viktor Oaustin, a lamplighter from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 6 to fill a gap in R-S10. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Viktor Oaustin lost a boot to the mud at R-S10. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fog hid the far end of R-S10. Viktor Oaustin kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
sugar_cubes745: On Day 3, Zeno Cubes arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Zeno Cubes put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Officers came to inspect R-F18. Zeno Cubes polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A sniper's bullet hit Zeno Cubes at R-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Zeno Cubes finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The surgeon worked on Zeno Cubes until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.

A letter came with Gideon "Mud" Cubes: "I am Zeno Cubes's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Gideon "Mud" Cubes wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dawn watch. Gideon "Mud" Cubes put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Wendel Yaboyslydude, grazed.
Gideon "Mud" Cubes had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Yaboyslydude crossed it, Gideon "Mud" Cubes fired. Wendel Yaboyslydude was badly wounded.
